data.name: Refund captured payment
data.description: Refunds a captured payment, by ID. For a full refund, include an empty payload in the JSON request body. For a partial refund, include an amount object in the JSON request body.
data.evaluateGuide: Refunds a captured PayPal payment by capture ID, either fully or partially. Use it to issue the refund and receive its result.\nUse for: full refunds, partial refunds, captured payment reversals\nNot supported: payment capture, payment retrieval, refund status lookup

data.name: Fetch a Specific Refund for a Payment
data.description: You can use this API to retrieve details of a specific refund made for a payment.
data.evaluateGuide: Retrieves details for one Razorpay refund associated with a payment. Use it to inspect a specific refund resource.\nUse for: refund detail lookup, refund verification, payment refund audit\nNot supported: creating refunds, listing all refunds, payment capture

data.name: Refund a payment
data.description: Refunds a payment that has been captured, and returns a unique reference for this request. You get the outcome of the request asynchronously, in a REFUND webhook.  You can refund either the full captured amount or a part of the captured amount. You can also perform multiple partial refunds, as long as their sum doesn't exceed the cap
data.evaluateGuide: Creates a full or partial refund for a captured Adyen payment. The outcome is delivered asynchronously through a refund webhook.\nUse for: full refunds, partial refunds, repeated partial refunds\nNot supported: uncaptured payment refunds, synchronous outcome retrieval, payment capture

data.name: Refund of a payment
data.description: Endpoint to refund an specific payment. Only successful payments can be refunded.
data.evaluateGuide: Refunds a specific successful ProntoPaga payment. Use it to reverse an eligible payment.\nUse for: successful payment refunds, payment reversals\nNot supported: unsuccessful payment refunds, refund lookup, payment capture

data.name: Get refund payment rails
data.evaluateGuide: Retrieves the payment rails associated with a Mastercard Open Finance refund. Use it to inspect how the refund is routed.\nUse for: refund rail lookup, refund routing inspection, payment rail details\nNot supported: creating refunds, changing rails, payment capture

data.name: Create a Normal Refund
data.description: You can use this API to create a normal refund for a payment.
data.evaluateGuide: Creates a normal refund for a Razorpay payment. Use it to return all or part of the captured payment according to the platform’s refund rules.\nUse for: standard refunds, partial refunds, payment reversals\nNot supported: instant refund processing, refund detail lookup, payment capture

data.name: GET /v2/processing/invoices/{invoiceID}/payments/{paymentID}/refunds/{refundID}
data.evaluateGuide: Retrieves one refund linked to a Vality invoice payment. Use it to inspect a refund by invoice, payment, and refund identifiers.\nUse for: refund detail lookup, invoice refund audit, payment refund verification\nNot supported: creating refunds, listing refunds, invoice payment creation

data.name: Create an Instant Refund
data.description: You can use this API to process refunds instantaneously to your customers.
data.evaluateGuide: Creates an instant refund for a Razorpay payment. Use it when the platform supports immediate refund processing for the customer.\nUse for: instant refunds, payment reversals, customer refund processing\nNot supported: normal refund creation, refund detail lookup, payment capture

data.name: Refund captured payment
data.description: Refunds a captured payment, by ID. For a full refund, include an empty payload in the JSON request body. For a partial refund, include an amount object in the JSON request body.
data.evaluateGuide: Refunds a captured PayPal payment by capture ID, either fully or partially. Use it to issue the refund and receive its result.\nUse for: full refunds, partial refunds, captured payment reversals\nNot supported: payment capture, payment retrieval, refund status lookup

data.name: Fetch Multiple Refunds for a Payment
data.description: You can use this API to retrieve multiple refunds for a payment.
data.evaluateGuide: Retrieves multiple Razorpay refunds associated with a payment. Use it to list the payment’s refund history.\nUse for: refund history, refund listing, payment refund audit\nNot supported: creating refunds, single refund detail lookup, payment capture
